name: openqr
title: OpenQR
description: Generate QR codes and manage dynamic (editable) QR codes with scan analytics, straight from Raycast.
author: sam_moreton

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Your OpenQR API key. Create one free at https://openqr.uk/api.

commands.name: generate-static-qr
commands.title: Generate Static QR Code
commands.subtitle: OpenQR
commands.description: Encode text or a URL as a permanent QR code and copy or save the image. Never expires, works with no server.

commands.name: generate-dynamic-qr
commands.title: Generate Dynamic QR Code
commands.subtitle: OpenQR
commands.description: Create an editable QR code you can re-point later without reprinting, and get its image.

commands.name: manage-dynamic-qr-codes
commands.title: Manage Dynamic QR Codes
commands.subtitle: OpenQR
commands.description: Browse your dynamic QR codes: show their images, re-point destinations, view scan analytics, and delete.
